limitations: Same three training seeds reused; combined trajectories are not independent new repeats.
Supplement selected after previous development results; adaptive selection and assessment on one dev set.
Four LR grid is finite; boundary winner is not a global optimum.
Controls cover only two LRs and moment matching does not uniquely identify causal mechanisms.
Small six-layer model and one corpus family; no general ability or isolated speed claim.
